# Annotation schema — field reference

*Generated from `src/seamless_curation/schema.py`; do not edit by hand.*

Eight tables, one per level. Every column lives on exactly one table; only keys
(`id`, `link`, `id_part`, `group_key`) and the partition columns (`vendor`,
`label`, `split`) repeat, and partitions always equal the parent row's value.
Higher-level summaries of clip concepts carry a level prefix
(`recording_posture` vs the clip's `posture`), so plain joins never collide.

| table | level | primary key | rows (annotations_v1) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `participants` | participant | `participant_key` | see annotation_summary.json |
| `sessions` | session | `session_key` | see annotation_summary.json |
| `prompts` | prompt | `prompt_hash` | see annotation_summary.json |
| `interactions` | interaction | `interaction_key` | see annotation_summary.json |
| `interaction_windows` | interaction_window | `window_id` | see annotation_summary.json |
| `recordings` | recording | `file_id` | see annotation_summary.json |
| `clips` | clip | `clip_id` | see annotation_summary.json |
| `moi_events` | moi_event | `moi_id` | see annotation_summary.json |

Column attributes:

* **role** — `id` primary key; `link` foreign key; `id_part` raw Meta id
  segment; `group_key` grouping key; `partition` vendor/label/split; `metadata`
  given attribute; `measure` continuous observation; `label` categorical
  annotation; `score` 0-1 annotation; `confidence` 0-1 support for a label or
  score; `status` why a value is or isn't present; `flag` non-null boolean.
* **provenance** — `meta:as_is` Meta's value unchanged; `meta:derived` computed
  by us from Meta's metadata/features; `prior:reused` a definition from the
  previous (filtering) pipeline reused unchanged and recomputed over every clip;
  `prior:adapted` a previous definition or threshold, changed (see the note);
  `fresh` new.
* **evidence** — `given` supplied by Meta; `parsed` decoded from an id or code;
  `measured` computed from released signals (SMPL-H and FAU are themselves model
  estimates); `rule_inferred` a category/flag from a stated rule on
  measurements; `aggregate` a summary of lower-level rows.
* **NA means** — when a column may be missing, exactly what a missing value
  means. A missing value never stands for zero.


## `participants` — participant level

| column | type | role | unit | allowed values | NA means | provenance | evidence | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `participant_key` | string | id |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | parsed | Vendor-qualified participant key, 'V00_P0061'. Bare participant ids collide across vendors (627 ids), so the vendor is part of the key. May carry Meta's 'A' suffix. |
| `vendor` | string | partition |  | `V00`, `V01`, `V02`, `V03` | never NA | meta:derived | parsed | Collection vendor (site), from the file id. Rigs, cameras and microphones differ by vendor. |
| `participant_id` | string | id_part |  |  | never NA | meta:as_is | given | Meta's participant id segment as it appears in file ids, zero-padded, including any 'A' suffix. Not unique across vendors. |
| `id_suffix` | string | metadata |  | `none`, `A` | never NA | meta:derived | parsed | 'A' when the participant id carries Meta's letter suffix (165 V00 ids), else 'none'. The suffix's meaning is undocumented; 182/183 suffixed metadata rows are 'Undisclosed'. |
| `suffix_sibling_key` | string | link |  |  | no sibling id exists in this vendor | meta:derived | parsed | The key of the same numeric id with/without the 'A' suffix in the same vendor, when both exist (51 V00 stems). Meta warns ids are sometimes duplicated or split across people; whether siblings are the same person is unconfirmed (they never share a session). |
| `metadata_status` | string | status |  | `numeric`, `undisclosed`, `missing_row` | never NA | meta:derived | given | State of this participant's participants.csv row: 'numeric' (BFI-2 scores present), 'undisclosed' (row present, scores 'Undisclosed'), 'missing_row' (no row for this vendor+id; BFI is never borrowed from another vendor's row). |
| `bfi_extraversion` | float32 | metadata | BFI-2 domain mean (1-5) |  | metadata_status is 'undisclosed' or 'missing_row' | meta:as_is | given | BFI-2 extraversion domain score as released (participants.csv extraversion_raw): the mean of the domain's items, 1-5. |
| `bfi_agreeableness` | float32 | metadata | BFI-2 domain mean (1-5) |  | metadata_status is 'undisclosed' or 'missing_row' | meta:as_is | given | BFI-2 agreeableness domain score as released (participants.csv agreeableness_raw): the mean of the domain's items, 1-5. |
| `bfi_conscientiousness` | float32 | metadata | BFI-2 domain mean (1-5) |  | metadata_status is 'undisclosed' or 'missing_row' | meta:as_is | given | BFI-2 conscientiousness domain score as released (participants.csv conscientiousness_raw): the mean of the domain's items, 1-5. |
| `bfi_neuroticism` | float32 | metadata | BFI-2 domain mean (1-5) |  | metadata_status is 'undisclosed' or 'missing_row' | meta:as_is | given | BFI-2 neuroticism domain score as released (participants.csv neuroticism_raw): the mean of the domain's items, 1-5. |
| `bfi_openness` | float32 | metadata | BFI-2 domain mean (1-5) |  | metadata_status is 'undisclosed' or 'missing_row' | meta:as_is | given | BFI-2 openness domain score as released (participants.csv openness_raw): the mean of the domain's items, 1-5. |
| `in_train` | bool | metadata |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | aggregate | The participant has at least one recording in Meta's official 'train' split. |
| `in_dev` | bool | metadata |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | aggregate | The participant has at least one recording in Meta's official 'dev' split. |
| `in_test` | bool | metadata |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | aggregate | The participant has at least one recording in Meta's official 'test' split. |
| `flag_split_conflict` | bool | flag |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | aggregate | The participant has recordings in more than one official split (26 participants, all spanning improvised and naturalistic). Evaluation that must be participant-disjoint should exclude them (and interactions with n_members_in_other_split > 0). |
| `flag_suffix_sibling_split_conflict` | bool | flag |  |  | never NA | fresh | aggregate | A suffix sibling exists (suffix_sibling_key) and its split set differs from this participant's: potential hidden leakage if the two ids are one person (7 of 51 stems). |
| `in_improvised` | bool | metadata |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | aggregate | The participant has at least one 'improvised' recording. |
| `in_naturalistic` | bool | metadata |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | aggregate | The participant has at least one 'naturalistic' recording. |
| `participant_n_sessions` | int32 | measure |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | aggregate | Sessions the participant appears in. |
| `participant_n_interactions` | int32 | measure |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | aggregate | Interactions the participant appears in. |
| `participant_n_recordings` | int32 | measure |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | aggregate | Recordings (files) of the participant. |
| `participant_n_partners` | int32 | measure |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | aggregate | Distinct partners the participant recorded with (1,393 participants have more than one). |
| `participant_recorded_hours` | float32 | measure | h |  | never NA | fresh | aggregate | Total duration of the participant's measured recordings. |
| `participant_component_id` | string | group_key |  |  | never NA | fresh | aggregate | Connected component of the co-participation graph (participants linked when they share a session). Grouping by it keeps every dyad, and every partner-of-partner, on one side of a custom split. Components are very unequal (the largest holds about a quarter of all files), so it suits grouped cross-validation, not balanced splits. Meta's official split is always the primary split. |

| column | type | role | unit | allowed values | NA means | provenance | evidence | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `session_key` | string | id |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | parsed | Vendor-qualified session key, 'V00_S0039'. Session ids collide across vendors. |

| `label` | string | partition |  | `improvised`, `naturalistic` | never NA | meta:as_is | given | Meta's collection category: 'improvised' (prompted scenarios with at least one professional actor) or 'naturalistic'. Constant within a session. |
| `split` | string | partition |  | `train`, `dev`, `test` | never NA | meta:as_is | given | Meta's official split, as released (filelist.csv), unchanged. Constant within a session and interaction. Splits are participant-level by design, but 26 participants appear in two splits: use participants.flag_split_conflict and interactions.n_members_in_other_split for leakage-free evaluation. |
| `session_id` | string | id_part |  |  | never NA | meta:as_is | given | Meta's 4-digit session id segment; not unique across vendors. |
| `relationship` | string | metadata |  | `stranger`, `familiar` | no relationships.csv row for this session (relationship_status == 'missing_row') | meta:as_is | given | Dyad familiarity for this session, as released (relationships.csv). Every improvised session with a row is 'stranger'. Session-level, not dyad-level: 9 of 219 recurring dyads change value between sessions. |
| `relationship_detail` | string | metadata |  | `stranger`, `friends`, `coworkers`, `family-generic`, `familiar-generic`, `dating/spouse/romantic_partner`, `classmates`, `siblings`, `parent_child`, `neighbors`, `roommates` | no relationships.csv row for this session | meta:as_is | given | Finer relationship category as released (friends, coworkers, family-generic, ...). |
| `relationship_status` | string | status |  | `present`, `missing_row` | never NA | meta:derived | given | 'present' or 'missing_row' (122 sessions have no relationships.csv row: 112 V01, the 9 single-participant V00 sessions, 1 V03). |
| `participant_key_1` | string | link |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | parsed | First participant of the session (sorted key order; the order carries no meaning). |
| `participant_key_2` | string | link |  |  | single-participant session (9 V00 sessions) | meta:derived | parsed | Second participant of the session (sorted key order). |
| `dyad_key` | string | group_key |  |  | never NA | fresh | parsed | Order-free key of the session's participant pair, 'V00_P0061+V00_P0062'. 219 dyads recorded more than one session. |
| `dyad_session_count` | int32 | measure |  |  | never NA | fresh | aggregate | Sessions this dyad recorded together. |
| `session_n_participants` | int8 | measure |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | aggregate | Participants in the session (1 or 2). |
| `session_n_interactions` | int32 | measure |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | aggregate | Interactions recorded in the session (1-20). |
| `session_n_interaction_types` | int8 | measure |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | aggregate | Distinct Meta interaction_type values among the session's prompts. |
| `session_duration_s` | float32 | measure | s |  | no interaction of the session could be measured | fresh | aggregate | Sum of the session's interaction durations (active time only; Meta's 'meta time' between interactions is not released). |
| `session_posture_consistent` | string | label |  | `yes`, `no`, `unknown` | never NA | fresh | aggregate | 'yes' when every participant's decided recording-level postures (standing/sitting) are the same across all of their recordings in this session, 'no' when a participant is standing in one interaction and sitting in another (or any recording is 'mixed'), 'unknown' when a participant has fewer than two decided recordings. |

## `prompts` — prompt level

| column | type | role | unit | allowed values | NA means | provenance | evidence | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt_hash` | string | id |  |  | never NA | meta:as_is | given | Meta's prompt id (interactions.csv prompt_hash, 8 digits). It equals the I-segment of file ids, which Meta calls interaction_id, but it identifies a PROMPT reused across up to 1,550 sessions — never group conversations by it; use interaction_key. |
| `prompt_id_unique` | string | metadata |  |  | never NA | meta:as_is | given | Meta's structured prompt identifier, as released. |
| `prompt_template` | string | metadata |  |  | prompt_id_unique has no P#### template (the RPx.y family) | meta:derived | parsed | Template id parsed from prompt_id_unique ('P0070'); groups prompt variants. |
| `prompt_version` | string | metadata |  |  | no version token | meta:derived | parsed | Prompt-set version parsed from prompt_id_unique ('v3.4'). |
| `prompt_context` | string | metadata |  | `fam`, `str`, `RP`, `AC`, `aac`, `AA`, `CC`, `DN`, `DP`, `EO`, `MN`, `MP`, `other` | never NA | meta:derived | parsed | Context tag parsed from prompt_id_unique: 'fam'/'str' (written for familiar/stranger dyads), 'RP' (role-play), 'AC'/'aac' (acting games), other two-letter set codes as released, 'other' when none parses. |
| `prompt_item_index` | int16 | metadata |  |  | prompt has no item suffix | meta:derived | parsed | The '-n' item suffix of grounded-gesture prompts (0-279). |
| `participant_a_prompt_text` | string | metadata |  |  | never NA | meta:as_is | given | Prompt text given to prompt role A, as released. Meta does not say which participant was role A. |
| `participant_b_prompt_text` | string | metadata |  |  | empty in interactions.csv | meta:as_is | given | Prompt text given to prompt role B, as released. |
| `ab_prompts_differ` | bool | metadata |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | parsed | The A and B prompt texts differ, so the two members had different instructions (true for ~91% of files). |
| `ipc_member_assignable` | bool | metadata |  |  | never NA | fresh | parsed | True only when both roles received the identical text, so ipc_a describes both members. Otherwise Meta provides no participant-to-role mapping and a per-member IPC cannot be assigned (deliberately not guessed). |
| `interaction_type` | string | metadata |  | `ipc_conversation`, `grounded_gesture`, `collaborative_storytelling`, `charades` | never NA | meta:as_is | given | Meta's interaction type for the prompt, as released. For 9 prompts (8,007 files) the prompt text contradicts it (see interaction_type_text_consistency); speech behaviour where checked follows the type, not the text, consistent with Meta's off-by-one prompt caveat. |
| `task_kind_from_text` | string | label |  | `discussion`, `storytelling`, `game`, `gesture_sentence`, `role_play`, `unclear` | never NA | fresh | rule_inferred | Task kind inferred from the A prompt text by keyword rules (see docs): discussion, storytelling, game (incl. charades-style acting), gesture_sentence, role_play, unclear. A topic handle, not ground truth. |
| `interaction_type_text_consistency` | string | label |  | `consistent`, `contradicts_text`, `unclear` | never NA | fresh | rule_inferred | Whether interaction_type agrees with task_kind_from_text: 'consistent', 'contradicts_text' (a proxy for Meta's prompt/text misalignment caveat), or 'unclear'. |
| `ipc_a` | string | metadata |  | `ANCP`, `AMCP`, `ANCM`, `APCP`, `APCN`, `AMCN`, `APCM`, `AMCM`, `CGST` | never NA | meta:as_is | given | Interpersonal-circumplex code of prompt role A, as released: A{P,N,M}C{P,N,M} = agency plus/neutral/minus x communion plus/neutral/minus (8 octants), or CGST (not an octant; personas suggest a cognitive state). An attribute of the prompt role, not of a participant. ipc_a is never empty. |
| `ipc_a_agency` | int8 | metadata |  | `-1`, `0`, `1` | ipc_a is CGST or absent | meta:derived | parsed | Agency axis of ipc_a decoded to +1/0/-1 (P/N/M). |
| `ipc_a_communion` | int8 | metadata |  | `-1`, `0`, `1` | ipc_a is CGST or absent | meta:derived | parsed | Communion axis of ipc_a decoded to +1/0/-1 (P/N/M). |
| `ipc_a_kind` | string | metadata |  | `octant`, `cognitive_state`, `absent` | never NA | meta:derived | parsed | 'octant', 'cognitive_state' (CGST) or 'absent' for ipc_a. |
| `ipc_b` | string | metadata |  | `ANCP`, `AMCP`, `ANCM`, `APCP`, `APCN`, `AMCN`, `APCM`, `AMCM`, `CGST` | no second IPC code given (single-sided prompt) | meta:as_is | given | Interpersonal-circumplex code of prompt role B, as released: A{P,N,M}C{P,N,M} = agency plus/neutral/minus x communion plus/neutral/minus (8 octants), or CGST (not an octant; personas suggest a cognitive state). An attribute of the prompt role, not of a participant. |
| `ipc_b_agency` | int8 | metadata |  | `-1`, `0`, `1` | ipc_b is CGST or absent | meta:derived | parsed | Agency axis of ipc_b decoded to +1/0/-1 (P/N/M). |
| `ipc_b_communion` | int8 | metadata |  | `-1`, `0`, `1` | ipc_b is CGST or absent | meta:derived | parsed | Communion axis of ipc_b decoded to +1/0/-1 (P/N/M). |
| `ipc_b_kind` | string | metadata |  | `octant`, `cognitive_state`, `absent` | never NA | meta:derived | parsed | 'octant', 'cognitive_state' (CGST) or 'absent' for ipc_b. |
| `prompt_n_sessions` | int32 | measure |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | aggregate | Sessions that used this prompt (median 26, max 1,550). High values mean the same prompt text recurs across train/dev/test (405 of 407 test prompts also occur in train). |
| `prompt_n_vendors` | int8 | measure |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | aggregate | Vendors that used this prompt. |

| column | type | role | unit | allowed values | NA means | provenance | evidence | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `interaction_key` | string | id |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | parsed | Conversation key, 'V00_S0039_I00000581' = (vendor, session, prompt). The unique id of one interaction instance; the bare I-segment is a prompt id. |
| `session_key` | string | link |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | parsed | Session of this interaction. |
| `prompt_hash` | string | link |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | parsed | Prompt of this interaction (join prompts for type, IPC, text). |
| `vendor` | string | partition |  | `V00`, `V01`, `V02`, `V03` | never NA | meta:derived | parsed | Collection vendor (site), from the file id. Rigs, cameras and microphones differ by vendor. |
| `label` | string | partition |  | `improvised`, `naturalistic` | never NA | meta:as_is | given | Meta's collection category: 'improvised' (prompted scenarios with at least one professional actor) or 'naturalistic'. Constant within a session. |
| `split` | string | partition |  | `train`, `dev`, `test` | never NA | meta:as_is | given | Meta's official split, as released (filelist.csv), unchanged. Constant within a session and interaction. Splits are participant-level by design, but 26 participants appear in two splits: use participants.flag_split_conflict and interactions.n_members_in_other_split for leakage-free evaluation. |
| `interaction_n_recordings` | int8 | measure |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | aggregate | Recordings (participants) released for this interaction: 2, or 1 for the 132 partner-missing interactions. |
| `pairing_status` | string | status |  | `paired`, `partner_missing` | never NA | meta:derived | aggregate | 'paired' (both participants' recordings released) or 'partner_missing' (132 V00 interactions in 9 single-participant sessions). |
| `member_file_id_1` | string | link |  |  | never NA | meta:derived | parsed | Recording of the first member (members sorted by participant_id; the order carries no prompt-role meaning). |
| `member_file_id_2` | string | link |  |  | partner_missing | meta:derived | parsed | Recording of the second member. |
| `interaction_n_members_measured` | int8 | measure |  |  | never NA | fresh | aggregate | Members whose recording could be measured (0, 1 or 2). Pair aggregates are NA unless both are. |
| `interaction_duration_s` | float32 | measure | s |  | no member measured | fresh | aggregate | Longer of the members' recording durations. |
| `pair_duration_diff_s` | float32 | measure | s |  | fewer than two measured members | fresh | aggregate | Absolute difference of the members' durations. |
| `pair_fps_differs` | bool | flag |  |  | never NA | fresh | aggregate | The members' frame rates differ (1,147 pairs, all V01); clips are aligned by time, so this matters only for frame-index arithmetic across partners (1,120 interactions). False when fewer than two members are measured. |
| `pair_duration_agreement` | string | status |  | `agree`, `minor_mismatch`, `major_mismatch`, `not_applicable` | never NA | fresh | rule_inferred | Whether the members' recordings agree in length: 'agree' (<= 0.1 s), 'minor_mismatch' (<= 1 s), 'major_mismatch' (> 1 s, or either member has timebase drift), 'not_applicable' (fewer than two measured members). A proxy for Meta's ~10% timestamp misalignment caveat, NOT Meta's list (none is published): 'agree' does not mean unaffected. partner_clip_id is only set when this is 'agree' or 'minor_mismatch'. |
| `speech_status` | string | status |  | `both_annotated`, `one_unannotated`, `both_unannotated`, `partner_missing`, `not_measured` | never NA | fresh | aggregate | Speech annotation state of the pair: 'both_annotated' (both members have VAD or transcript speech), 'one_unannotated', 'both_unannotated' (both have empty VAD and transcript; silence and missing annotation are indistinguishable), 'partner_missing', 'not_measured'. Pair speech fields are NA unless 'both_annotated' and durations align. |
| `interaction_speech_overlap_frac` | float32 | measure |  |  | no dyad window with both members' speech annotated (speech_status != 'both_annotated', pair_duration_agreement 'major_mismatch'/'not_applicable', or every window has an unannotated member clip), or (balance/overlap) neither member speaks | fresh | aggregate | Share of time either member speaks during which both speak. High values can be real overlap or speaker bleed (see recordings.recording_transcript_echo_frac). |
| `interaction_mutual_silence_frac` | float32 | measure |  |  | no dyad window with both members' speech annotated (speech_status != 'both_annotated', pair_duration_agreement 'major_mismatch'/'not_applicable', or every window has an unannotated member clip), or (balance/overlap) neither member speaks | fresh | aggregate | Share of the shared interval in which neither member speaks. |
| `interaction_speech_balance` | float32 | measure |  |  | no dyad window with both members' speech annotated (speech_status != 'both_annotated', pair_duration_agreement 'major_mismatch'/'not_applicable', or every window has an unannotated member clip), or (balance/overlap) neither member speaks | fresh | aggregate | Balance of speaking time, min/max of the members' own-speech seconds (1 = equal, 0 = one-sided). |
| `interaction_turn_switch_rate_per_min` | float32 | measure | 1/min |  | no dyad window with both members' speech annotated (speech_status != 'both_annotated', pair_duration_agreement 'major_mismatch'/'not_applicable', or every window has an unannotated member clip), or (balance/overlap) neither member speaks | fresh | aggregate | Changes of floor holder (the sole speaker at 10 Hz) per minute, counted within dyad windows (a change across a window boundary is not counted). |
| `interaction_pair_speech_coverage_frac` | float32 | measure |  |  | as interaction_speech_overlap_frac | fresh | aggregate | Share of interaction_duration_s covered by the dyad windows the pair speech measures are computed over (both members' speech annotated): 1 for most conversations; lower where a member's VAD drops out or its WAV is short. |
| `interaction_n_clips` | int32 | measure |  |  | never NA | fresh | aggregate | Clips over all members of the interaction. |
| `posture_pair` | string | label |  |  | never NA | fresh | aggregate | The members' recording-level posture labels, sorted and joined with '+' ('standing+standing', 'sitting+standing', 'mixed+standing', ...); 'absent' stands in for a missing partner. A dyad configuration for conditioning; per-window pairs are in interaction_windows.window_posture_pair. |
| `any_member_posture_transition` | string | label |  | `yes`, `no`, `unknown` | never NA | fresh | aggregate | 'yes' if either member's recording has a sustained standing<->sitting change, 'no' if neither does and both are decided, else 'unknown'. |
| `interaction_expressivity_mean` | float32 | score |  |  | fewer than two members with measured expressivity | fresh | aggregate | Mean clip expressivity_score over both members' measured clips (duration-weighted). A mean of percentiles concentrates near 0.5; compare conversations by rank, not against the clip-level 1/3 and 2/3 cuts. |
| `interaction_expressivity_gap` | float32 | measure |  |  | fewer than two members with measured expressivity | fresh | aggregate | Absolute difference of the two members' mean clip expressivity_score (0-1 scale). |
| `moi_3p_coverage` | string | status |  | `both`, `one`, `none` | never NA | meta:derived | given | How many members have Meta 3P MOI annotations: 'both', 'one', 'none' (coverage differs within pairs: 487 pairs have one member only). |
| `moi_duplication_3p` | string | label |  | `none`, `partial`, `full`, `not_applicable`, `not_measured` | never NA | fresh | rule_inferred | Whether 3P MOI events are copied between the members (same kind, same normalised text, start within 2 s): 'none', 'partial', 'full', 'not_applicable' (coverage != both) or 'not_measured' (both annotated per Meta's flags but a member's files could not be read). Mostly V03 (session S0203), plus 3 V00 pairs; a duplicated event's target person is ambiguous. |
| `moi_1p_coverage` | string | status |  | `both`, `one`, `none` | never NA | meta:derived | given | How many members have Meta 1P MOI annotations: 'both', 'one', 'none' (coverage differs within pairs: 419 pairs have one member only). |
| `moi_duplication_1p` | string | label |  | `none`, `partial`, `full`, `not_applicable`, `not_measured` | never NA | fresh | rule_inferred | Whether 1P MOI events are copied between the members (same kind, same normalised text, start within 2 s): 'none', 'partial', 'full', 'not_applicable' (coverage != both) or 'not_measured' (both annotated per Meta's flags but a member's files could not be read). Mostly V03 (session S0203), plus 3 V00 pairs; a duplicated event's target person is ambiguous. |
| `interaction_moi_3p_count` | int32 | measure |  |  | moi_3p_coverage != 'both', or a member's recording could not be measured | meta:derived | aggregate | Sum of the two members' distinct 3P MOI counts (a moment copied to both members, see moi_duplication_3p, counts once per member). |
| `n_members_in_other_split` | int8 | measure |  |  | never NA | fresh | aggregate | Members whose participant also has recordings in an official split other than this interaction's (0, 1 or 2). For participant-disjoint evaluation keep split in {dev, test} AND this == 0: 25% of dev and 13% of test interactions have a member with train files. |
| `n_members_suffix_sibling_other_split` | int8 | measure |  |  | never NA | fresh | aggregate | Members whose A-suffix sibling id has recordings in another split (unconfirmed identity; a stricter leakage filter). |

## `interaction_windows` — interaction_window level

| column | type | role | unit | allowed values | NA means | provenance | evidence | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `window_id` | string | id |  |  | never NA | fresh | parsed | Dyad window key, '<interaction_key>_L30_W003': the interval [k*L, (k+1)*L) of the interaction, shared by the two members' clip k. |

## `moi_events` — moi_event level

| column | type | role | unit | allowed values | NA means | provenance | evidence | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `moi_id` | string | id |  |  | never NA | fresh | parsed | Event key '<file_id>_M3PIS_002' (kind and index within the file). |
| `file_id` | string | link |  |  | never NA | fresh | parsed | Recording annotated. |
| `interaction_key` | string | link |  |  | never NA | fresh | parsed | Conversation. |
| `participant_key` | string | link |  |  | never NA | fresh | parsed | Participant the annotation is about. |
| `vendor` | string | partition |  | `V00`, `V01`, `V02`, `V03` | never NA | meta:derived | parsed | Collection vendor (site), from the file id. Rigs, cameras and microphones differ by vendor. |
| `label` | string | partition |  | `improvised`, `naturalistic` | never NA | meta:as_is | given | Meta's collection category: 'improvised' (prompted scenarios with at least one professional actor) or 'naturalistic'. Constant within a session. |
| `split` | string | partition |  | `train`, `dev`, `test` | never NA | meta:as_is | given | Meta's official split, as released (filelist.csv), unchanged. Constant within a session and interaction. Splits are participant-level by design, but 26 participants appear in two splits: use participants.flag_split_conflict and interactions.n_members_in_other_split for leakage-free evaluation. |
| `annotation_kind` | string | metadata |  | `1P-IS`, `1P-R`, `3P-IS`, `3P-R`, `3P-V` | never NA | meta:as_is | given | Meta annotation type: 1P-IS (self-reported internal state), 1P-R (self rationale), 3P-IS (observer-perceived state), 3P-R (observer rationale), 3P-V (observer visual description). |
| `party` | string | metadata |  | `1P`, `3P` | never NA | meta:derived | given | '1P' or '3P'. |
| `moi_start_s` | float32 | measure | s |  | never NA | meta:as_is | given | Start, integer seconds from recording start, as released. |
| `moi_end_s` | float32 | measure | s |  | never NA | meta:as_is | given | End, as released. |
| `moi_duration_s` | float32 | measure | s |  | never NA | meta:derived | given | moi_end_s - moi_start_s (can be 0 or negative as released). |
| `moi_text` | string | metadata |  |  | never NA | meta:as_is | given | The annotation text, as released. |
| `moi_clip_index_start` | int16 | measure |  |  | the recording has no clips, or the event lies wholly at or after the recording's end | fresh | measured | Clip index containing the event start (on the nominal k*L grid; MOI times are whole seconds). |
| `moi_clip_index_end` | int16 | measure |  |  | as moi_clip_index_start | fresh | measured | Clip index containing the event's last instant. |
| `moi_malformed` | string | status |  | `ok`, `zero_length`, `negative_length`, `beyond_recording` | never NA | meta:derived | rule_inferred | 'ok', 'zero_length', 'negative_length', 'beyond_recording' (ends > 0.5 s after the recording). |
| `partner_duplicate_moi_id` | string | link |  |  | no duplicate in the partner's annotations | fresh | rule_inferred | The partner's event with the same kind, same normalised text and start within 2 s: a copied annotation whose target person is ambiguous. |
